content: Ẹ́mmaanà cha Samwẹl

Iwa ọkhaam ojinọng kw'okpen Ẹlkana. Ofon Rama k'okhubha kwa Zuph, ka mgbegbeho s'Ephraim. Kẹ wa ode nnwa kw'ijinọng kwa Jeroham. Jeroham wa ode nnwa kw'Elihu, Elihu ode nnwa kwa Tohu, kwa Zuph kw'ofon Ephraim obhoni.
Iwa Ẹlkana ọtzọk panọng afa p'akpen Hana ọmaana Pẹnina. Wa Pẹnina ọmaani va, yina, Hana nnwa kọmaani.

Wa cho kpenamkpen, Ẹlkana om-obina k'obhon kwẹ, ọtza okpobha Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Ẹfa biphyir ka Shilo, obiro osi ẹjafọhni ọnang-ẹ. Wa va p'ijinọng p'Ẹli p'ade Hophni, ọmaana Phinẹhas, bọ iwa ade afọhnẹja p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ka Shilo.
Ogbe obebeng kw'Ẹlkana otza osi ẹjafọhni, om-okkema nden ọtzọkha ọnang Pẹnina, ttara va pẹ biphyir, p'ijinọng ọmaana p'ipanọng.
Yina, wa ọm-ọnang Hana ekkema ch'ede igbe ifa ka ch'ọnangi oyok, okhuri idadaakha s'ọkhaam ọmaana Hana, ttara bi da iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oni Hana ọmmaan ọ̀nangi.
Iwa oyokh-ọbhọbha kwa Hana om-olukh-ẹ, okhuri da Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oni Hana ọmmaan ọnangi, ifha ettem ẹyakh-ẹ atzim.
Iwa ilulukhi nna ichin ororo ka cho kpenamkpen. K'ogbe kpenamkpen kwa Hana ochin k'ọhọhm kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, oyokh-ọbhọbha om-olukh-ẹ maa, Hana om-obhom, obiro obhum ọchattọhk ochichi.
Ẹlkana kw'ode odim kwẹ, ọm-ọbọbh-ẹ bi, “Hana, mbọng f'am-abhom o? Asi yan am-abhum ọchattọhk ochichi o? Nkwu-osisi sọ s'ettem nde yan o? Kaam mbar odik mach'ira va p'ijinọng jobh abar e.”

Iwa ewu dani ka Shilo, mada bẹ akk'ọchattọhk akyera ochichi, bẹ abira akyera atzuk ogwo-ogwo, Hana obina obobe. M'ogbe nwa, Ẹli kw'ode ọfọhnẹja owobh ẹwọr k'ogbera kw'om-owobha k'ẹkpọmmachi ch'ọhọhm kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
K'ọmmamma kw'owobh-ẹ k'ettem, Hana obhom, ozi njọhm ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.

Ọn-ọtzọkha ọnwọhngi, oben bi, “O Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Ẹfa biphyir, idikha kọ afha are ọmmamma kwa kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ, abira ajim-m, ọtzọhmnọng kwọ karaam, anang-m nnwa kw'ijinọng, kaam ńdọkh-ẹ nnang-ọ k'akpen pẹ biphyir, ẹkpẹr manda dani ch'ephyuri isisa sẹ kéde.”
Wa mada Hana ochin ororo om-ozi njọhm ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, Ẹli om-okhẹ-ẹ otzum k'ẹmma.
Wa Hana om-ozi njọhm k'ettem ẹtzaanga, mmakpa sẹ mminyebh, yina, ọwọhng k'iyaan koyini. Mẹ wọ, Ẹli on-ochibhi bi, Hana ọkk'atzuk obuma.
On-oben-ẹ bi, “Ogbe obhir otzuma yan, kwa kọ awobha k'etzuk-buma o? Kwọbha ibubuma sọ.”

Mẹ wọ, Hana on-obhina bi, “Itta kwaam, kwẹ mando kode. Kaam nde kwanọng kw'owobh k'ọmmamma kw'ideden e. Kaam atzuk manda bani ndimi mmingwa, kaam mmimgbaak Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọmmamma kw'ettem chaam e.
Kọ, kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ mach'inọng-dama kàtzọkha. Kaam mminzi njọhm s'ifon k'iyayakhi-dik saam s'ideden, ttara ittem-dọkhiji-dik saam e.”
Mẹ wọ e, Ẹli obhin-ẹ bi, “Kọ rọhng k'odidiri. Tte Ibinọkpaabyi kw'anọng p'Israẹl akpobh, ọnang-ọ idik s'akk'ẹ aphyema.”
Hana obhin-ẹ bi, “Tte kaam ọtzọhmnọng kwọ ndọkha ọphyaam ka kọ k'itzitzikha.” Mẹ wọ, on-okpira itzitzikha, obiro ofona ọtza ochi ọchattọhk.

K'ekpekpebha ch'ewu ehobh, bẹ abina atza akpobha Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Mada bẹ akk'akyera, bẹ akpa nnam abhana ka Rama, kw'ode obhon kwabẹ. Iwa Ẹlkana oyima Hana abẹ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọbhaanga njọhm sa Hana.
Okwu opyiri k'ogbe mẹ, Hana otzima ibhọr, ọmaan ojinọng, ọkpẹ-ẹ Samwẹl
, oben bi, “Kaam mphyem-ẹ k'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.”
Hana ọtzọk Samwẹl ọnang Ibinọkpaabyi
Mada Ẹlkana otzim ẹhọhmmọr chẹ biphyir ochina k'ọhọhm kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, ifha otza osi ẹjafọhni cha cho, obiro otzuk ọnwọhngi kwẹ,
wa Hana bẹ abẹ kọ̀tzọni. On-oben odim bi, “Idikha nkk'nnwa ẹba ndima, kaam ńdọkh-ẹ nchena Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi k'ọhọhm kwẹ, kẹ óruk akpen pẹ mẹ biphyir, k'ogbe kpenamkpen.”
Mẹ wọ, Ẹlkana obhin-ẹ bi, “Si mach'abeni, kọ wobha ma matzẹmaa atzim-ẹ ẹba. Tte Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okhinggẹ ohok echekhi ch'atzim pọ.” Mẹ wọ, kwanọng nwa owobha ọrọk nnwa kwẹ, maa otzim-ẹ ẹba.
Mada okk'nnwa ẹba otzima, ọtzọkh-ẹ da otzim ọkhar-ọkhara, ọmaana ọbhaamnwa kwa cho attaan, ọmaana ẹgbangbang-dim ch'abubuma, ttara otzuk-gbere otzima ochina k'ọhọhm kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ka Shilo.
Mada bẹ akk'ọbhaam-nwa nwa afha atzima asi ẹjafọhni, bẹ atzọkha nnwa nwa achena Ẹli.
Hana on-oben Ẹli bi, “O itta kwaam tzotzokhaan, da kọ achin ororo aruk akpen, kaam nchekhi k'akpen pọ bi, kaam wọ nde kwanọng kw'iwa mbe ma, mminzi njọhm nnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi e.
Wa kaam nzi njọhm mphyem Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi nnwa nwa, ma, okk'ephyema nduma chaam ọbhaanga e.
Mẹ wọ, kaam nna-ndọk nnwa nwa nnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi e. Kẹ ón-ode kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi k'akpen pẹ biphyir.” Mẹ wọ e, bẹ achunga mẹ anang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ikpokpobha.

footnotes.text: 1.20 K'eHiburu, Samwẹl ede che ch'eyini odik, ebir ekher ọwọhng kw'ode bi, “Che chẹ ede Ibinọkpaabyi.” Wa Hana ọnangi nnwa kwẹ che nda ifha ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi abarada, okhuri da Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọnang-ẹ ebhina k'ephyema chẹ.
